subject: QBR prep: launch velocity heatcheck + dependency handoff
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics <maria.gomez@acme-analytics.com>, acme-ops@example.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: launch velocity heatcheck + dependency handoff

Team —

With QBR in two weeks I want a short, factual heatcheck on the product/eng roadmap for the June launch lane. Goal is to produce a single-page summary for SLT that lists: committed milestones, stretch milestones, active blocking dependencies, and a mitigation owner for each blocker.

Please respond with the following by EOD Tuesday:
- One-line status for your area (green/yellow/red) and percent likely to hit the committed milestone.
- Any newly surfaced infra or partner dependencies we must escalate.
- One recommended mitigation with owner and ETA.

I've copied Acme to keep them aware of timing and any changes that affect their integration window. Attachments: I'll collect artifacts (runbook, infra deps spreadsheet) into the QBR folder once I have them.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics <maria.gomez@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: launch velocity heatcheck + dependency handoff

Karthik —

Status (product roadmap): YELLOW — 78% on committed milestones.
Key notes:
- Feature set for Personas 2.0 is complete from product spec POV, but there's a breaking contract change in the inference API (model metadata header) that Infra flagged. That change will require a compatibility shim in the SDKs; if we don't ship the shim, customer integrations (like Acme) may require a patch on their side.
- New blocker: INF-9247 (infra team needs final sign-off on config rollout).

Recommended mitigation: land a backwards-compatible header fallback in SDKs and schedule a one-week compatibility canary for 1% traffic. Owner: Lauren. ETA: build + canary by 2027-05-12; full ramp by 2027-05-19.

I've attached the infra dependency sheet with annotations (infra-deps-v2.xlsx).

Thanks,
Lauren
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: infra-deps-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet listing infra owners, SLA, impact level)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics <maria.gomez@acme-analytics.com>, acme-ops@example.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: launch velocity heatcheck + dependency handoff

Karthik / team —

Status (engineering): YELLOW — 72% on committed milestones. Detailed points:
- We can implement the SDK header fallback, but it requires a short infra flag rollout and a config migration for dedicated fleets. That ties to INF-9247. If INF-9247 slips >5 days, the canary window compresses and rollout risk goes up to HIGH.
- Test coverage for the new persona routing needs an extra integration sprint to validate long-tail latency under load. Without that, we risk a late perf regression.

Mitigations proposed:
1) Ship SDK fallback + short-term compatibility layer (owner: Stephanie) — ETA: 2027-05-12 (build), canary 2027-05-13 to 2027-05-17.
2) Add a focused integration sprint for persona-routing tests (owner: David Kim) — ETA start 2027-05-11, finish 2027-05-18.

I attached a draft canary and rollback playbook (canary-playbook.md) and updated the QBR action tracker with engineering tasks (qbr-action-tracker.csv).

- Steph
Engineering Lead, Platform
Redwood Inference

---

Attachment stubs: canary-playbook.md, qbr-action-tracker.csv

From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme-analytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Ops <acme-ops@example.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:35:00 -0500
Subject: Re: QBR prep: launch velocity heatcheck + dependency handoff

Karthik —

Thanks for the heads up. From Acme's side: our integration window begins 2027-05-20. The SDK header change is a concern because we embed Redwood calls in a managed connector that can't be hot-swapped quickly. Two asks:
1) If SDK fallback is used, can you confirm the connector will not see duplicated events during the canary?
2) If the config migration affects dedicated fleets, can Redwood provide a short compatibility guide and a contact for debugging during the first 48 hours of our ramp?

If either of those are risky for us, we may need to shift our internal cutover by one week. Please advise.

Best,
Maria Gomez
Head of Integrations, Acme Analytics

Attachment stubs: none on this message

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme-analytics.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 16:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: launch velocity heatcheck + dependency handoff

Maria / team —

Short answers up front:
1) SDK fallback: we will implement a header fallback that avoids duplicate events; the SDK will suppress duplicates by de-duplicating on request id for the rollout window. Owner: Stephanie / SDK team.
2) Dedicated fleet migration: we will publish a 2-page compatibility guide and assign a dedicated on-call for the first 48 hours of Acme's ramp. Owner: David Kim.

Consolidated mitigation plan and next steps (for the SLT one-pager):
- Risk: INF-9247 infra rollout sign-off — Impact: HIGH; Probability: MEDIUM. Mitigation: prioritize sign-off, deploy canary 5/13. Owner: Lauren.
- Risk: SDK compatibility — Impact: MEDIUM; Probability: LOW (with fallback). Mitigation: land fallback + canary. Owner: Stephanie.
- Risk: Persona-routing perf — Impact: MEDIUM; Probability: MEDIUM. Mitigation: integration sprint and focused perf tests. Owner: David.

Action items by Tuesday EOD (2027-05-11):
- Lauren: confirm infra rollout gating checklist and expected sign-off date.
- Stephanie: submit SDK fallback PR and schedule canary start.
- David: finalize on-call contact and publish compatibility guide in shared Drive.
- Karthik: compile one-pager for SLT and share QBR folder link.

Maria — I will also put the compatibility guide and the canary playbook in the QBR drive and flag the HubSpot deal HS-48291 so our CSM can coordinate the cutover. If Acme still needs to move by a week, say so and we'll treat that as a timeline change for the QBR summary.

Thanks all —
Karthik
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
